metadata.title: Micron Keeps Falling as Memory Stocks Get Agonizingly Cheap. The Next Catalyst.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Keeps Falling as Memory Stocks Get Agonizingly Cheap. The Next Catalyst.
The tech selloff was persisting into Friday as embattled chip and memory stocks couldn’t catch a break after Anthropic initial public offering failed to rescue the artifical intelligence trade.
